shared_elements: upright stone monument with rounded top
circle/disc motif (chest disc vs. winged sun-disc)
incised linear signs/symbols in banded registers
justification: Both are upright, round-topped stone monuments whose decoration is organised into stacked horizontal zones, with a prominent disc high on the composition and frontal human forms below, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a massive three-dimensional dark boulder-sculpture with a single blocky figure carved in bold, weathered high relief, whereas B is a thin pale slab covered in fine, shallow, delicately incised registers of small figures and dense rows of script.
